# Maine Coon Heaven
> Maine Coon Heaven Australia — Ethical Maine Coon Breeders & Pedigree Kittens for Sale

Maine Coon Heaven Australia is a trusted registered Maine Coon breeder in Sydney, NSW, offering purebred Maine Coon kittens for sale to loving homes in Sydney, Melbourne, Canberra, Perth, Adelaide, and across Australia.

Located in Sydney, NSW, Australia, founded in 2019. All kittens are 100% DNA health tested (HCM, SMA, PKDef clear), raised underfoot, and placed with full certified pedigree papers.

## Key Policies
- Reservation Deposit: $750 AUD standard ($1,000 AUD for Shadow & Greenbean), applied toward total adoption fee
- Refund Policy: We can only refund the complete amount paid for the kitten. Partial refunds or split deductions are not issued—any eligible refund returns 100% of the full amount paid toward your kitten.
- Minimum Adoption: $0 AUD
- Transport: Complimentary safe flight transport and local pickup for Sydney, Melbourne, Canberra, Perth, NSW, Adelaide, Brisbane, and Hobart
- Payment Methods: Bank Transfer, PayID, crypto-BTC, crypto-USDT
- Crypto Discount: 10% instant discount for payments via BTC or USDT
- WhatsApp Coordinator: +61 401 667 279
- Inquiries: mainecoonheavenau00@gmail.com
